metadata.title: PortabilityRisk: occurrence-level portability architecture of acquired antimicrobial resistance determinants across complete bacterial genomes
metadata.description:
Occurrence-level computational assignments for acquired antimicrobial resistance determinants across complete closed bacterial genomes.

74,349 acquired antimicrobial resistance gene occurrences in 6,288 closed complete Gram-negative genomes. One row is one determinant call at one coordinate interval on one replicon in one assembly.

Direct chromosome/plasmid replicon resolution. Every occurrence is assigned to a documented chromosome or plasmid using NCBI molecule designations rather than prediction: 100 % resolution, 0 unmatched, 0 ambiguous, 0 missing coordinates. This is documentation, not inference, and it holds because every genome in the cohort is closed. It does not transfer to draft assemblies.

An operational five-class A–E framework. A chromosomal with no mobile-element marker within ±10 kb (18,837); B chromosomal with at least one marker (16,303); C plasmid with no mobility marker (7,170); D plasmid relaxase-positive (6,043); E plasmid relaxase and MPF positive (25,996). A+B = 35,140 chromosomal; C+D+E = 39,209 plasmid. The classes are operational, not biological: class A is not "immobile" and class C is not "non-mobilizable" — both are statements about what a marker database returned.

Homology-based and structural evidence are recorded as distinct levels. Homology-based mobile-element proximity means a profile-homology marker lies within an occurrence's own ±10 kb window. Structurally resolved complete insertion-sequence detection means a complete transposase open reading frame with bilateral resolved terminal inverted repeats lies fully inside that window. The two are never conflated, and the accompanying evidence-level dictionary states what each does not establish.

No transfer experiment, conjugation phenotype or active transposition was measured. There is no mating assay, no transposition assay and no phenotype in this dataset. Claims of demonstrated transfer, observed horizontal gene transfer, active transposition or mobilization are not supported by it.

Accompanying schemas, dictionaries and checksums are included. A full data dictionary defining every field; denominator and evidence-level dictionaries; pinned software and database versions; a provenance map; a claim-to-evidence crosswalk; JSON Schema for every table; SHA-256 checksums and a per-file manifest; and a standalone verification script that re-derives every headline denominator from the archive alone and reports its own disagreement count.

Funding. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial or not-for-profit sectors. Cloud-computing resources were supported through promotional credits provided by Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.

Licence note. Analysis code is licensed separately under Apache-2.0 and is published in the linked repository. Source genome records from NCBI remain governed by NCBI's terms; this dataset contains accessions and computed values derived from them, not redistributed sequence.
